question:
Select the most appropriate one-word substute for the underlined segment in the given sentence.

She provided a __compact and precise__ summary of her research work.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Succinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"succinct"** means clearly and briefly expressed, without unnecessary words. (संक्षिप्त)

 
 
• **Example:** The professor gave a succinct explanation of the complex topic, making it easy for everyone to understand.
 
 
 
• In the given sentence, the term "compact and precise summary" is best described by the word **"succinct."** (संक्षिप्त)
 
 
• **Example:** Her succinct presentation covered all the main points in just five minutes.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Succinct**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Redundant** (अतिरिक्त): Something that is unnecessary, repetitive, or no longer needed.

 
 
• **Example:** The report was filled with redundant information, making it unnecessarily long.
 
 
 
• **Verbose** (शब्दाडंबरपूर्ण): Using more words than necessary; wordy.
 
 
• **Example:** His verbose speech made it difficult to focus on the main point.
 
 
 
• **Diffuse** (फैलाना): Spread over a large area; not concentrated or concise.
 
 
• **Example:** The article was so diffuse that it was hard to understand the key message.
